key_insight: Radial Kernel Attention enables linear-cost global feature exchange, improving energy and force prediction for polymer-derived clusters.
engineering_relevance: RKA offers a compact way to capture interactions beyond local neighbor graphs without the quadratic cost of all-pair attention.
method: Map atomic distances from the cluster centroid into learned radial features.
Combine radial-feature overlap with content-dependent queries and keys using factorized aggregation.
Insert invariant scalar updates between EquiformerV3 local blocks and differentiate total energy to obtain conservative forces.
evidence_signal: After 12 training epochs on OPoly26, complete official validation-split evaluation showed 67.4% lower per-atom energy MAE and 36.3% lower force MAE in a matched 5M-model comparison; the 20M RKA model achieved 15.81 meV total-energy MAE and 2.619 meV/angstrom force MAE.
watch_item: Results cover finite polymer-derived clusters; performance on periodic bulk polymers and stability in long molecular-dynamics trajectories remain unestablished by the abstract.
paper_title: Radial Kernel Attention for Long-Range Modeling in Polymer Machine Learning Force Fields
